cause_quote: AuthorName computed `const index = query ? fold(props.name).indexOf(fold(query)) : -1` on the NFD-folded name, then sliced the original with `props.name.slice(index, index + query.length)`, so the offsets went wrong whenever folding changed the string length.
user_saw: In the Dashboards author filter search, Korean or decomposed-accent names had nothing bolded or the wrong letters bolded (e.g. no bold for 민 in 김민수, final 'a' plain in García).
summary: Added matchFoldedQuery to map a match found in the folded name back to the original name's span, and used it for the author-name highlight, sharing one foldSearchText with the filter.
